verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows are explicitly documented as an 'automation engine' that runs structured actions automatically based on trigger events and run conditions, with 152 available action types spanning Slack, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident ops — enabling background automations like auto-creating channels, notifying stakeholders, filing tickets, and starting retros without manual intervention. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming autonomous background execution in practice, and clearer detail on trigger types (e.g., scheduled/webhook triggers) beyond docs summaries.
